title: Patton's army rushes to Pilsen before Berlin

tellings.quote: you see General Patton's army arrive and they steamroll, like you said, to Pilsen before going to Berlin, which is very interesting.

plain: In 1945 General Patton's army raced to Pilsen in Czechoslovakia and "steamroll[ed]" there before going on to Berlin. The researcher Jason Simosa points this out to Michels, without naming a source, and calls it "very interesting". The hint is that something in Pilsen was worth reaching first, before the German capital.
